summary: Saudi Arabia's King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh was closed after explosions were heard, with 221 flights cancelled and ambulances dispatched. Yemeni Houthi forces deployed high-density naval mines in the Bab al-Mandab strait. Israel conducted an airstrike in southern Syria killing a Syrian militant accused of operating under Iranian direction.
key_points: Saudi Arabia's King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh was evacuated and closed after explosions, with 221 flights cancelled and ambulances responding. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/82274)
Yemeni Houthi forces placed high-density naval mines in the Bab al-Mandab strait, threatening maritime traffic. (Source: @kianmeli1/93181)
Israeli airstrike in southern Syria killed Syrian militant Yousef Ali Al-Hassan, accused of planning attacks against Israeli forces under Iranian direction. (Source: @idf_telegram/25325)
Over 100 international organizations stated the Gaza ceasefire "exists only on paper" due to ongoing Israeli attacks and aid restrictions. (Source: @presstv/210220)
Palestinian Authority President Abbas postponed legislative elections from November 2026 to September 2027, combining them with presidential elections. (Source: @presstv/210223)
Israeli air defense missile launched from northern Israel toward southern Lebanon, with Israeli media reporting an intercept over Lebanese territory. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/398466)
Explosions and artillery shelling reported in Al-Qulay'ah and Wadi al-Saluqi in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/47445)
Yemeni Armed Forces announced upcoming footage showing securing of Sam', Al-Salu, Al-Mawasit districts and surrender of Saudi-backed groups. (Source: @naya_foriraq/93162)

points: Iran retains ballistic missile and drone production capabilities with large stockpiles, and Russia is supplying missiles, per Bloomberg report citing Iranian resilience despite potential renewed conflict with US. (Source: @asafroz/54196)

Iranian President Pezeshkian held a trilateral meeting with Russian President Putin and Azerbaijani President Aliyev in Turkmenistan, signaling regional diplomatic coordination. (Source: @asafroz/54199)

Former US President Trump claimed Iran was two to three weeks from a nuclear weapon before US B-2 strikes, asserting Iran would target Israel, Europe, and US cities like Los Angeles and San Diego if armed. (Source: @VahidOnline/78675)
Iranian former Foreign Minister Zarif faced internal criticism accusing him of being an "Israeli and American mercenary" following his recent speeches. (Source: @kianmeli1/93182)

Israeli airstrike in southern Syria eliminated Syrian militant Yousef Ali Al-Hassan, who promoted terror attacks against Israeli civilians and forces in southern Syria under Iranian direction over the past year. (Source: @idf_telegram/25325)

Israeli air defense system launched an interceptor missile from northern border settlements toward southern Lebanon, with Israeli media reporting an intercept over area where Israeli forces operate inside Lebanon. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/398466, @rasedal3ado138e/398471)

Israeli forces killed an Islamic Jihad company commander who participated in the October 7 attack and a Hamas militant in a joint Shin Bet and IDF operation. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94569, @yediotnews25/135998)

Over 100 humanitarian organizations declared the Gaza ceasefire "exists only on paper," citing continued Israeli attacks and restrictions on aid and reconstruction a year after the agreement. (Source: @presstv/210220)
IDF reiterated commitment to the Israel-Lebanon agreement while pledging to continue removing immediate threats across all sectors. (Source: @idf_telegram/25325)

The Gaza ceasefire is described as "existing only on paper" by over 100 international organizations due to ongoing Israeli military operations and severe restrictions on humanitarian aid and reconstruction. (Source: @presstv/210220)

Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas issued a decree canceling legislative elections scheduled for November 28, 2026, and setting September 11, 2027, for simultaneous presidential and parliamentary elections. (Source: @presstv/210223)
Multiple explosions occurred in the Al-Qulay'ah field area between 05:20 and 08:00 local time, according to Lebanese sources. (Source: @redlinkleb/47445)
Artillery shelling targeted the Wadi al-Saluqi area in southern Lebanon, with live map updates indicating ongoing bombardment. (Source: @redlinkleb/47357)

An Israeli air defense missile was launched from northern Israeli settlements toward southern Lebanon, with Israeli media reporting an intercept over Lebanese territory where Israeli forces are present. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/398466, @rasedal3ado138e/398471)
IDF stated it remains committed to the Israel-Lebanon agreement while continuing to act against immediate threats in all sectors. (Source: @idf_telegram/25325)

Israeli airstrike in southern Syria killed Syrian militant Yousef Ali Al-Hassan, who was advancing terror plots against Israeli forces in southern Syria under Iranian guidance, including explosive drone and rocket launches over the past year. (Source: @idf_telegram/25325)

Saudi Arabia's King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh was fully shut down after explosions were heard, with 221 flights cancelled and over a dozen ambulances dispatched to the scene. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/82274, @Faytuks_Network/8091)
Fires broke out in multiple locations in Al-Ahsa and north, northeast, and northwest of Riyadh starting at 0600Z and continued burning. (Source: @shin_persian/10910)
Yemeni Houthi forces deployed high-density naval mines in the Bab al-Mandab strait, posing a significant threat to international shipping lanes. (Source: @kianmeli1/93181)

Yemeni Armed Forces released FPV drone footage showing attacks on Saudi-backed mercenaries, and announced upcoming footage of securing Sam', Al-Salu, and Al-Mawasit districts and surrender of Saudi-backed groups. (Source: @presstv/210228, @naya_foriraq/93162)
A Saudi-backed offensive toward Dhubab in Yemen collapsed within hours, exposing false battlefield claims and information warfare failures amid Yemeni military advances. (Source: @presstv/210233)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous closure of Riyadh's international airport and Houthi mining of Bab al-Mandab indicates a significant escalation in Yemeni-Saudi hostilities, potentially disrupting global energy shipping. Israel's targeted killing of an Iranian-directed Syrian militant in southern Syria demonstrates continued kinetic pressure on Iran's regional proxy network. The Gaza ceasefire's effective collapse, per 100+ NGOs, suggests a return to high-intensity conflict absent diplomatic intervention. These developments collectively raise the risk of multi-front escalation involving Iran, its proxies, and Israel.
sections.regional_response: Saudi authorities have not officially commented on the airport explosions, while Yemeni forces publicize military gains in Dhubab and Bab al-Mandab. Iran's diplomatic engagement with Russia and Azerbaijan signals attempts to bolster strategic partnerships amid US pressure. The European Union and Netherlands pledged to protect the ICC from US sanctions, reflecting Western institutional divisions. Palestinian Authority's election postponement indicates internal political maneuvering amid external pressure.
sections.intelligence_notes: Reports of fires near Riyadh and Al-Ahsa alongside airport explosions suggest possible drone or missile strikes, though attribution remains unconfirmed. The high-density mining of Bab al-Mandab represents a new phase in Houthi maritime interdiction capabilities. Israel's public acknowledgment of the Syrian strike indicates a shift toward overt attribution of anti-Iran operations. The discrepancy between Israeli claims of ceasefire compliance and NGO assessments highlights information warfare dimensions.
